# Data Dictionary — `hospital_admissions_clean.csv`

**Source:** Synthetic, de-identified data generated by `scripts/01_generate_data.py` (seed 42). No real patient records were used. Patterns were built in on purpose so the analysis has realistic relationships to find; they are **not** clinical evidence.
**Period:** 1 Jan 2023 – 31 Dec 2024 (admission dates).
**Grain:** One row = one hospital admission (stay). A patient can have several rows.
**Currency:** Indian Rupees (INR).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| admission_id | text | Unique ID of the stay (primary key). |
| patient_id | text | Pseudonymous patient ID (links repeat stays). |
| admission_date / discharge_date | date | Start and end of the stay (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| admission_year, admission_month, admission_weekday | derived | Calendar fields from admission_date. Month as YYYY-MM. |
| age | int | Age in years at admission. |
| age_group | derived | 0-17, 18-34, 35-49, 50-64, 65-79, 80+. |
| age_imputed | bool | True if age was missing or invalid and filled in during cleaning. |
| gender | text | Male / Female (standardised). |
| insurance_type | text | Private, Government Scheme, Self-Pay, Corporate, Unknown. |
| comorbidity_count | int | Number of recorded chronic conditions besides the main diagnosis. |
| comorbidity_band | derived | 0, 1-2, 3-4, 5+. |
| prior_admissions_12m | derived | Number of this patient's admissions in the 365 days before this one (recomputed from the data). |
| primary_diagnosis | text | Main reason for admission (16 conditions). |
| department | text | Treating department (9 departments, standardised names). |
| admission_type | text | Emergency, Urgent, Elective. |
| admission_source | text | Emergency Dept, Physician Referral, Transfer, Unknown. |
| length_of_stay | derived int | discharge_date − admission_date in days (same-day = 0). |
| los_band | derived | 0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15+ days. |
| icu_days | int | Days spent in intensive care during the stay. |
| discharge_disposition | text | Home, Home with Care, Skilled Nursing/Rehab, Left Against Advice, Expired, Unknown. |
| total_cost | float | Total billed cost of the stay (INR). Missing for 1.5% of stays (153) — not imputed. |
| cost_per_day | derived float | total_cost / max(length_of_stay, 1). |
| cost_corrected | bool | True if a mis-keyed cost (extra zero) was corrected. |
| high_cost | derived bool | total_cost in the top 10% of stays. |
| days_to_next_admission | derived | Days from this discharge to the patient's next admission (blank if none). |
| readmit_eligible | derived bool | False for stays ending in death or discharged in the last 30 days of the data (follow-up incomplete). |
| readmitted_30d | derived bool | True if the patient was admitted again within 30 days of discharge (any cause) and the stay is eligible. |

## Metric definitions (used identically in analysis, SQL, Power BI and dashboard)

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| Admissions | Count of rows. |
| Average length of stay (ALOS) | Mean of length_of_stay over all stays. Median also reported because stays are right-skewed. |
| 30-day readmission rate | Sum of readmitted_30d ÷ count of stays where readmit_eligible = True. |
| Average cost per stay | Mean of total_cost over stays where cost is not missing. |
| Total cost | Sum of total_cost (missing excluded). |
| In-hospital mortality | Share of stays with discharge_disposition = Expired. |

## Known limitations
- Synthetic data: useful to demonstrate method, not to draw medical conclusions.
- Readmissions are "any cause" and only counted if the patient returns to this same hospital.
- No information on severity scores, medications or social factors, which strongly affect stay and readmission in real life.
- Correlation, not causation: e.g. older patients stay longer, but age is not proven to *cause* longer stays.
